$comment: Phase-2 wave-2 OpenConnector ingestion config for Austria. concurrentie-analyse/scripts/sync/sync_austria_datagvat.py runs TWO sources - (1) OpenTender/OCP's `.jsonl.gz` bulk registry (publication 46) and (2) a data.gv.at CKAN fallback used only when the OCDS download fails - and this file ports the PRIMARY (OCDS bulk) path, which is the richer per-record source. Engine path: gzip + JSONL bulk, the exact path openconnector#105 added (`Source.configuration.decompress:"gzip"` + `Synchronization.sourceConfig.format:"jsonl"`) and which slovenia_ocds.json/romania_seap.json already live-verified 2026-07-07 - the engine gunzips the `.gz` body, splits it line-by-line, json_decode's each line as one OCDS release, before the whole-document JSON/XML attempts. This is the OpenTender/DIGIWHIST platform (CC BY-NC-SA, non-commercial) - approved for INTERNAL ANALYSIS ONLY per README.md's standing decisions (2026-07-06); re-open the moment any OpenTender-derived data feeds a customer-facing product. Production endpoint below is `full.jsonl.gz` (complete continuously-updated historical export, no annual config maintenance); the weekly Job's synchronization-contract-keyed dedup makes re-fetching the whole file cheap in ingestion terms. Field paths carried over from the script's own OCDS extraction (ocid, tender.title/description, buyer.name, tender.tenderPeriod.endDate, tender.value.amount/currency, tender.items[].classification.id, tender.procurementMethodDetails, tender.mainProcurementCategory); optional fields Twig-wrapped with |default('') per IMPORT.md; `cpvCodes` is a bare dot-path to `tender.items.0.classification.id` + cast:array (best-effort single code, the script fans out items[]+additionalClassifications[] which a declarative dot-path cannot). closingDate is the raw OCDS `tender.tenderPeriod.endDate` full ISO datetime (NOT sliced to date-only - the tender schema field is format:date-time, the same fix romania_seap/slovenia needed 2026-07-07). Awards live inline in `awards[]` but are not fanned out to spectr `tenderAward` objects (declarative one-source->one-target limit, see australia_austender.json's $comment for the same reasoning). The script's own CPV/keyword IT filter is a DB-side layer, not an API constraint - this connector ingests the full unfiltered feed. Needs a comfortable PHP memory_limit for the gunzip+per-line pass on `full.jsonl.gz` (slovenia_ocds.json confirmed 4G fine on the spike; verify headroom on lower-memory deployments before enabling in production). LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-07-07 on the isolated spectr-spike instance against a small single-year export (to keep the live-fire gentle) - see connectors/README.md's W2 table and IMPORT.md for the run evidence.

objects.name: OCP Data Registry - Austria (publication 46)
objects.description: Open Contracting Partnership's maintained OCDS bulk export for Austria (publication 46), the primary source sync_austria_datagvat.py targets. Public, unauthenticated `.jsonl.gz` bulk. CC BY-NC-SA (non-commercial) - internal-analysis-only per README.md standing decisions. Feeds the spectr `tender` register/schema via the austria-opentender-to-spectr-tender synchronization.

objects.name: Austria OpenTender to Spectr Tender
objects.description: Maps a single decompressed OCDS release (one JSONL line) from OCP publication 46 onto the spectr `tender` schema. Mirrors sync_austria_datagvat.py's OCDS-path extraction. Optional fields Twig-wrapped per IMPORT.md; cpvCodes bare dot-path + cast:array; closingDate keeps the raw full ISO datetime (schema field is date-time).

objects.name: Austria OpenTender to Spectr Tender
objects.description: Wave-2 ingestion sync: OCP publication 46's decompressed OCDS releases -> spectr register, tender schema. `sourceConfig.format:"jsonl"` (oc#105) makes the engine gunzip the `.gz` body and parse it as line-delimited JSON before the whole-document json_decode/XML fallback; `resultsPosition: '_root'` returns the parsed JSONL records array unchanged. Production endpoint `full.jsonl.gz` (complete historical export); `usesPagination: false` (single bulk file per call).

objects.name: Austria OpenTender Weekly Sync
objects.description: Runs the austria-opentender-to-spectr-tender synchronization weekly. Fetches the complete `full.jsonl.gz` export in a single HTTP request each run; the synchronization-contract-keyed upsert dedups on re-run. Enabled 2026-07-07 after live-verifying the gzip+JSONL path (oc#105) against a small single-year export on the spectr-spike.
